subject: Congrats on series c!!
text:
Hey [NAME],
Congrats on the $150M, that's a huge milestone.
We work with AgTech R&D teams like Carbon Robotics and Aigen where the
challenge is making sure models are actually learning the edge cases that
domain experts already know to look for such as early disease signals,
ripeness variation, unusual growth patterns.
Given you're expanding into new fruit types and scaling farms, I think
there's a timely conversation.
Worth 15 minutes? Also heading to CVPR in Denver in June if that's easier.

subject: Training data for KAI World Model
text:
Hi,

Congrats on the KAI launch, the KAI Halo approach to egocentric data
collection is a smart way to build the world model.

The bottleneck teams hit at this stage is usually on the labeling and
curation side: structuring that first-person data at scale to actually move
model performance.

We work with several humanoid teams on exactly this. Worth a quick call?

subject: [SENDER] Everheart recommended I reach out | Encord
text:
Hi [NAME],

[SENDER] Everheart pointed me your way after we spoke earlier today.

Enterprise AI teams at Baker Hughes, Hitachi, and AXA came to us with the
same challenge: separate tools for annotation, curation, and GenAI
evaluation created data silos and slowed iteration across initiatives.

Encord sits underneath as the unified data layer, multimodal by default,
handling everything from annotation + curation to preference ranking for
chatbot output evaluation.

Worth 20 mins next week to compare notes on what's working for them?
Tuesdays and Wednesdays usually work well for me

subject: [SENDER] Karimi recommended I reach out | Working w/ Baker Hughes + Hitachi Energy
text:
Hi [NAME],

[SENDER] Karimi pointed me your way today and mentioned you lead vendor
assessment.

Saw you folks are scaling [COMPANY]'s CV pillar across PPE, leak detection,
corrosion, downhole imaging, and now VLMs for multimodal reasoning.

CV leads at Baker Hughes and Hitachi Energy hit similar walls scaling
diverse workloads: annotation bottlenecks, engineers stuck on QA instead of
model dev, and zero margin for error on safety-critical applications.

Encord is their data layer for multimodal annotation, curation, and
evaluation.

[SENDER] floated a Lunch & Learn down the line. Worth a 15-min chat first to
compare notes? Tuesdays/Wednesdays work best for me.

subject: Ode to a Hawaiian Slice
text:
On golden crust, a debate is born,
Where pineapple sits, both praised and scorned.
Sweet yellow chunks beside the ham,
A controversial, glorious jam.
Tomato sauce, a crimson sea,
Cradles toppings in harmony.
Mozzarella stretches, white and warm,
Weathering every critic's storm.
Some say fruit has no place here,
That Italy weeps a single tear.
But one bold bite, and you'll confess
This island twist is pure finesse.
The smoky pig, the tropic fruit,
A flavor combo none refute
Once they've surrendered to the blend
Of sweet and salt that never ends.

By the way are you the right person for ML ops infrastructure? We work with
similar teams on the data pipeline side (annotation, curation, and model
eval) and I'd love to compare notes if it's in your domain.
